Subject: Re: Post-demo summary + security items we agreed to follow up on

John — looping in details on the pen-test and vuln management side. Short summary: 

- Pen testing: Redwood engages a third-party assessor for an external network/app pen test annually. The most recent full pen test was completed 2025-11-15. We can share a redacted PDF of findings under an NDA or via a secure file share.
- Continuous scanning: we run authenticated SCA/SAST pipelines on PRs (every commit), daily vulnerability scans for container images and infra dependencies, and weekly DAST for hosted endpoints.
- SLA / remediation windows (company standard recommended):
  * Critical (RCE / auth bypass / data exfil): remediation or mitigation in 48–72 hours, emergency patching cadence as needed.
  * High (privilege escalation, sensitive data exposure): 7 business days for mitigation plan; final fix within 30 calendar days depending on complexity.
  * Medium: 30 days.
  * Low: 90 days or next maintenance window.

- Disclosure & tracking: issues are tracked in our internal Jira and assigned CVE processes where applicable. Reporting to customers occurs via redacted findings or a summary of mitigations. For Brightline we can provide either: (1) redacted report + attestations, or (2) full report under mutual NDA and a secure transfer (SFTP or secure Drive link).

Attached is a proposed scope (PenTest_Scope_Brightline.xlsx) — Rafael.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PenTest_Scope_Brightline.xlsx]
